author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಿಡುಕದಿರು ನಿನಜತೆಗೆ ಅನ್ಯರನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿರೆ 
ತೊಡಗಿರಲಿ ತನುಮನವು ಪರರನುದ್ಧರಿಸೆ
ಮಿಡಿತವಿರೆ ಮನದೊಳಗೆ ನಿನ್ನಂತೇ ಪರರೆಡೆಗೆ
ನಡಿಗೆಯದೆ ಸತ್ಯದೆಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t snap if others are compared with you;
let body and mind be engaged in lifting others up;
if your heart beats for others as it does for you,
that is the walk toward truth, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Don’t resent comparison. Put your energy into helping others, and feel for them as for yourself; that is the road to truth.
